summary.text: Muriel Hall is a Democratic state representative from Merrimack 9 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An educator, she lives in Bow, New Hampshire.

paragraphs.text: Muriel Hall earned an A.A. in foreign languages from Mt. San Antonio College, a B.S. in elementary education from Keene State College, and an M.Ed. in computer technology from Plymouth State University.
Her career experience includes working as an educator.
Ballotpedia lists her tenure in the New Hampshire House as beginning in 2021.
